hypothesis: Passing unchanged, autograd-connected raw table rows from an uncompiled caller into the compiled GPT core reduces A2 cold startup enough to increase useful fixed-budget training while preserving exact training and evaluation arithmetic.
single_causal_change: Default-OFF --ngram-gather-outside-compile moves the existing on-device hashes and weight[rows].to(COMPUTE_DTYPE) outside the compiled GPT region; table projections, dense gradients, AVG reduction, clipping and replicated RMSProp remain unchanged.
prediction_scope: Subjective 80% interval for a matched same-host cold full-budget ON-minus-OFF comparison, not a measured gain or a warm-to-official conversion; useful-step value is uncertain.

candidate_shortlist.idea: Raw table rows outside the compiled core
candidate_shortlist.why_ranked: Explicit newest human priority; source puts large tables in model graph; an exact CPU falsifier precedes hardware.

selection_rationale: Smallest causal intervention matching the newest compile-first directive, with a strong arithmetic invariant and a fast rejection path. This revisits a September12 proposal for cold compiler cost only: September15 four-rank reshard-hunt evidence already falsified the old steady-state dynamic-address resharding explanation. No claim that extraction automatically removes cross-core resharding.
host_hour_scope: Planning cap for a gated diagnostic plus matched cold full-budget pair and fresh evaluations, conditional on CPU success; additional replicas require a follow-up plan.
ev_definition: Subjective p_delta_le_minus_0_001 * abs(predicted_bpb_delta) / estimated_host_hours. Not an observed score.
trainium_feasibility: Static A2 tuple has four [32,1024,128] BF16 tensors (32 MiB total); original table Parameters, full dense backward, AVG all-reduce and BF16 RMSProp are preserved at world4/LNC2. Projection/Muon specializations remain. Backend may still reshard, compile eager primitives or duplicate backward regions; graph identity and cold fifth-boundary measurements are mandatory. SBUF policy, compiler environment and source are unchanged.
cheapest_falsifier: Independent source review and CPU synthetic ON/OFF loss, dense-gradient, three-step parameter/RMS-state and stateless-eval identity, plus a counting-backend graph capture proving no table-sized Parameter or table-index op enters the intended core. Native proof is required after those pass; see FALSIFIER.md.
duplicate_finding: Exact eager-gather/compiled-inner idea was proposed September12 but no implementing experiment found. Existing prof_driver --ngram-hoist/--ngram-merge-gather keep gathers inside whole-model compile and had null results. September15 four-rank static-vs-dynamic experiment closed the steady-state reshard mechanism (0.0 +/-1.6ms), so only current cold compiler cost is reopened. Advanced indexing is already ON; sparse optimizer candidate was rejected.

control.box_constraint: Same host/day, same final candidate bytes, exact A2 flags, same compiler environment, seed42 and equivalently empty proven cache roots; only gather flag differs. Existing A2 five-step run cannot be the control.
control.binding_note: The listed hash is the implementation parent. Before any native dispatch, bind both OFF and ON requests to the same new reviewed candidate commit/hash; if adopting the separately reviewed timing patch, bind both to that shared base too. This document supplies no dispatch authority.

candidate.expected_diff: One default-OFF parser flag; uncompiled raw-row training caller; optional stable row-tuple input to the shared GPT forward/projection path; both compile-only and training call sites wired. No optimizer, loader, timing, evaluator or SDK edit.
candidate.control_argv_difference: Replace --ngram-gather-outside-compile with --no-ngram-gather-outside-compile and use the distinct OFF output/label.

success_criteria.quality: Only fresh-process public-20M/context1024 after a valid cold fixed-1800s run can support a BPB claim. Use unchanged decide.py with valid matched same-host controls and required replication. Warm research BPB cannot establish cold submission eligibility.
success_criteria.throughput: Mechanism passes only with a verified compiler boundary, at least 10% lower measured cold process-to-fifth-boundary startup versus OFF and no greater than 3% regression in paired stable whole-step median. Record total distinct graph count; a graph-count decrease is not asserted in advance. Submission planning target is <=870s measured startup, actual cap900s; slower startup must still be charged in a valid full replay.
success_criteria.correctness: CPU OFF equals pinned parent for >=3 steps; ON/OFF exact CPU forward, dense grads, parameters and RMS state including collisions; same parameter identities/keys; four-rank G2 and RMS trace; no NaN/crash/budget violation; loadable consolidated checkpoint; pure causal batch-independent eval. Native graphs and numerical agreement require separate verification.

abort_conditions: Any independent correctness or identity gate fails
Gather remains inside the compiled core or autograd is detached
Graph/cold timing attribution is missing: do not call the mechanism proven
New SDK flag, data/evaluator/timing edit, sparse update or stateful eval is needed: return a distinct proposal
Native compile or budget fails, or checkpoint/evaluation is missing; archive failure without relaxed gates
Warm-only evidence is presented as cold proof
